meta.title: Review Queue
meta.tagline: Draft cards mined from 10 years of YC batches, awaiting manual review before joining the main atlas.
about: Every card here was pulled from YC's public company directory (Winter 2016 through Fall 2026), filtered for real funding/traction by an LLM, and drafted into a card — but none of it has been read by a human yet.
This is a separate, isolated graph on purpose: nothing here should be mistaken for a vetted entry in the main atlas until it's been checked and, if it holds up, moved over.
Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, press / to search.
